note: Praxion promo. Repurposes the pacing of the source video (cold open, a short brief, terse status cards alternating with results, a climax, a call to action) with original visuals, script and structure.

scenes.tr: Bu, Praxion. Minecraft'ı insan gibi oynayan ve oynarken kendi becerilerini yazan bir yapay zekâ ajanı.
scenes.en: This is Praxion. An AI agent that plays Minecraft like a person, and writes its own skills while it plays.

scenes.tr: Ona tek bir cümle söylemen yeter.
scenes.en: One sentence is all it needs.

scenes.tr: Önce plan yapar, nedenini söyler, sonra oynar.
scenes.en: It plans first, says why, then plays.

scenes.tr: Etrafını görür, sesleri duyar, tehlikeden kaçar.
scenes.en: It sees what is around, hears what is coming, and gets out of the way.

scenes.tr: Bilmediği bir işle karşılaşınca becerisini kendi yazar, dener ve doğrular.
scenes.en: When it meets a job it cannot do, it writes the skill, practises it, and proves it works.
scenes.card_en: No skill for this. Writing one.

scenes.tr: Her kararı görürsün: ne düşündü, neyi seçti, ne kadar sürdü.
scenes.en: You see every decision: what it thought, what it chose, how long it took.
From wood to iron. On its own.
Praxion. It learns while it plays.
